notes:
CLIOPATRIA ROW. 'Later Western Liang' (561-586) starts six years after the state (555) and ends a year early (587). Wikidata Q4186404 is shared with the Cliopatria row 'Western Liang' (407-409), which is Li Gao's Western Liang of the Sixteen Kingdoms (400-421); the two are different states 150 years apart, so this dossier covers only the Name 'Later Western Liang' and the Wikipedia title 'Western Liang (555-587)'. The shape (about 70,000 km2, central Hubei) matches the page's location; no area is given to compare.
WHAT THE PAGES GIVE. The Western Liang page is thin: infobox years without months, the three rulers and 'puppet state of Western Wei, Northern Zhou, and Sui dynasty' (the suzerain's dossier records the vassalage: western-wei from 555, northern-zhou from 557, sui-dynasty from 581). It does not date the Chen relation, the 561 cession or the 587 events; those come from the Chen page. The Sui page opened is silent on the Western Liang.
NOT SETTLED. Which provinces the Zhou gave in 571; where Xiao Zhuang's territory lay (Ying Province is read as eastern Hubei); what the Chen got from the 587 defection (about 390 km2 in Cliopatria's Chen shape). Xiao Xian's Liang (617-621) occupied the former Western Liang territory and is a separate state (xiao-xian-s-liang).
PAGE BUDGET. Western Liang (555-587) plus the shared Chen, Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou and Yuwen Tai pages.
